utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can check who still needs repairs and spread the word. I’ll also keep an eye out for Leo’s time and place and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mina — I’m sorting the screws and checking the tape inventory now. If I hear the repair drive time, I’ll let Faye know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, thanks. I’m still watching for Leo’s time and place, and I’ll keep checking who needs repairs so we can spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll spread the word once the time’s set. And it sounds like Gus already has some tools lined up, which should help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the confirmed time and location before I help spread the word. Once Quinn or Uli sends the details, I can pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That makes sense — I’ll keep an ear out too and pass it along once Quinn or Uli confirm the time and location.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help once the timing and pickup details are confirmed, and we’ve got the supplies and plan set. If you lock down the location, Opal can head straight over too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So to confirm, you’ve got the repair drive timing and pickup details, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not quite yet — I still need the timing and pickup details confirmed, plus the supplies and plan in place. Once that’s set, I can help and Opal can head over right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Once the repair drive location is confirmed, I’ll head straight over and send Pia the timing and pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help this afternoon too—just let me know when the location’s set and I’ll head over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—I'll send the timing and pickup details as soon as the location is confirmed, and then I’ll head straight over. We can use your help loading the truck too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s on Sunday at the community board, so I can work around the school schedule. I’ll let Leo and Opal know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that clears the location. Once the timing, pickup details, and supplies are settled, Pia can help, and I’ll keep Ira and Jules updated too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks — once Oren has the time, I can fit it around Sunday and keep everything lined up with the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and connect anyone who wants to pitch in. Dane can help this afternoon, and Vik can tell folks he can start with donations and then help load the truck.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, that helps a lot. I’ll sort the donated tools and keep the lend-out ones separate at Leo’s place this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll keep getting the word out and point anyone eager to help your way. Thanks for sorting the tools at Leo’s place this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Noah — that really helps. Tess and Cleo are both on the list, so the word’s definitely getting around!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Nice, glad it’s getting around. Saturday should work for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, Saturday works great for the repair drive. I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure folks know to come by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring gloves, a flashlight, and a few basic tools, and I’ll start by the mailboxes and work down the list. Just send me the time and place when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Bo. I’ll sort the rest and send the time and place soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — Saturday works. Just send the time and place when you’ve got it, and I’ll be there with the gloves and flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — I’ve got the sign-up list ready, and Sunday at the community board is still set. If you spot anything else we’ll need before then, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye out for anything else we need. I’ve got a few supplies to bring for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Cleo — thank you for bringing supplies. I’ll keep the list updated, and we’ll be set for Sunday at the community board.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still planning to come by the repair drive, and I’ll keep an ear out for any updates. If I hear anything new, I’ll let Eli know right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — it’s still on Saturday, and I’ll send Noah the time and location once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, thanks, Mara — I’m glad it’s still on Saturday. I’ll keep listening for any updates and pass them along if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, Eli’s putting together the clear list of what’s left and sending it to Ira, while Dane starts with donations and then the truck. Jules will keep linking up helpers, and Nell’s still sorting the pieces out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Gus can lend a few more tools, and Rey can help with tools and hands too. Dane can also help this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll pass that along too—Gus can bring a few more tools, and Rey can help with tools and hands, while Dane can still jump in this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with tools and a steady pair of hands on Saturday. I can also check in with Mina about who still needs repairs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Rey—Saturday at the community center is the repair drive, and I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands. If anyone needs tools or a hand, I’ll send them to Gus.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I’ll check with Mina and be there Saturday with tools and an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still in for the repair drive, and I’ll keep an ear out for any updates. If I hear anything new, I’ll let Eli know right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess — I’m out running errands, so I’ll keep an ear out too and send anyone needing a hand over to Gus.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good, Ira — thanks. I’ll keep listening for repair drive updates and pass anything new along to Eli.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Rosa’s got the sign-up list and the fixes we still need. Gus can lend some tools, and Rey said he can help with tools and hands too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, once the repair drive location is confirmed I’ll head straight over and send Pia the timing and pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal. Once the location’s set, I’ll pass it along and keep the list moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sunday at the community board is still the plan. Bring any repair requests to my porch or leave a note there, and I’ll add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Rosa. I’ll make a clear list of what’s left and send it to Ira.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Eli—thank you. I’ll keep the sign-up list updated and make sure we’re ready for Sunday at the community board.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep spreading the word once the time’s set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Nell — I’ll send Noah the confirmed time and location for Saturday as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — once you know, I’ll pass it along too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — it’s Saturday, and I’ll bring gloves, a flashlight, and a few basic tools. Leo’s sending the time and place, and I’ll start by the mailboxes and work down the list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help this afternoon too — just point me to where you need me, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — once Leo sends the time and place, meet us there and help with whatever’s left. Gus can lend a few more tools if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll check the repair drive time right now and let Faye know as soon as I can. Also, I’m sorting the screws and tape so we’re ready when everyone arrives.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Oren — that’s a huge help. I’ll keep spreading the word so Tess, Cleo, and everyone else know it’s coming together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m on it — I’ll confirm the time and tell Faye right away. Then I’ll finish up the screws and tape so we’re set for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s on Sunday at the community center, and I’m bringing a few supplies. Quinn saved me a spot, so I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ve got a few tools ready to lend, and I’ll bring them by when Leo’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll keep an eye out for you on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll sort through the donated tools and keep the lend-out ones set aside. If anything’s ready to loan, I’ll keep it separated for the team.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam. I can help with the tools and steady hands on Saturday, and I’ll check in with Mina about who still needs repairs.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be great, Rey—thanks. I’ll keep the lend-out tools separated and let the team know what’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s on Sunday at the community board, and I can work around the school schedule if needed. I’ll let you and Opal know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye. I’ll sort the rest and send the time and place for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Leo — just send the time and place when you have it, and I’ll keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Nell's still putting the repair drive pieces together, and once she confirms them, Jules will send the details to you. Dane can start with donations and then help load the truck.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ll wait for Quinn’s confirmed date, time, and meeting spot before I help. Once the details are set, I can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — once Quinn confirms the date, time, and meeting spot, I’ll pass the details along to you. Eli’s also putting together the remaining repair drive list for Ira.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the repair drive is on Saturday. I’ll keep an ear out for the time and meeting spot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so you’ll confirm the time and pickup spot with Pia, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll check with Pia about the time and meeting spot. Then I’ll pass the details along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can check who still needs repairs and help spread the word. I’ll keep an eye out for Leo’s time and place and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Mina — that helps a lot. I’ll keep spreading the word, and I’ll send Hana the time and meeting spot as soon as they’re confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll watch for Leo’s time and place and share it right away.
